blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Phone scams impose substantial and growing costs on individuals and financial systems worldwide, yet existing countermeasures impose no resource cost on perpetrators. Strategic scam-baiting, in which automated agents engage scammers to deplete their operational capacity, offers a proactive alternative but requires dynamic strategy adaptation that static systems cannot provide. We introduce a game-theoretic framework enabling LLMs to learn effective counter-strategies through in-context experience without fine-tuning. The framework models scammer-baiter interactions as a two-player game with empirically grounded strategies and utility functions, using Nash equilibrium as a formal benchmark for evaluating learned behaviour. Across 300 simulated dialogues and three LLM architectures, adaptive strategy selection achieves 28.9-79.7% closer alignment to Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines. The code and an annotated dataset of 300 dialogues with turn-level strategy labels and utility scores are released at https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_/ .
blocks.zh: 电话骗局给全世界的个人和金融体系带来巨大和不断增长的成本,而现有的对策却不对犯罪者造成资源成本。 战略诈骗,即自动代理商雇用欺诈者耗尽其业务能力,提供了一个主动积极的替代办法,但需要动态战略调整,而静态系统是无法提供的。 我们引入了一个游戏理论框架,使LLMs能够通过内在的文字经验学习有效的反战略,而不进行微调. 框架模型是骗局者-赌博者的互动,作为双玩家游戏,具有基于经验的战略和效用功能,将纳什均衡作为评价所学行为的正式基准. 在300个模拟对话和三个LLM架构中,适应性战略选择比非适应性基线更接近纳什平衡,达到28.9%-79.7%。 在https://github.com/nardinebasta/GameofPhones_/上发布了300个对话框的代码和附加说明的数据集,并附有转弯战略标签和功用分数。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Phone scams impose substantial and growing costs on individuals and financial systems worldwide. In 2024, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission recorded consumer fraud losses exceeding $12 billion, with phone calls remaining one of the dominant delivery vectors [ 9 ] . The increasing integration of generative AI into scam infrastructure has further accelerated the pace at which scripts evolve, significantly outpacing the adaptation cycles of conventional defences [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 电话骗局给全世界的个人和金融体系造成了巨大和不断增长的代价。 2024年,美国联邦贸易委员会记录到消费者欺诈损失超过120亿美元,电话仍然是主要的送货载体之一[9]. 基因AI日益融入骗局基础设施,进一步加快了剧本的发展速度,大大超过了常规防御的适应周期[21].

blocks.en: Existing countermeasures like call blocking, blacklisting, and ML-based detection [ 15 , 6 ] operate reactively. They impose no cost on the scammer, who can immediately redirect resources towards new targets. Scam-baiting , in which an agent impersonates a potential victim to waste scammers’ time, offers a fundamentally different posture. Early automated approaches [ 2 , 3 ] demonstrate feasibility but rely on static templates and fixed heuristics, leaving them ineffective against operators who adapt to recognise and disengage from bots.
blocks.zh: 现有的反措施,如阻断呼叫、列入黑名单和基于ML的探测[15、6]是反应性的。 它们不给骗子带来任何费用,他们可以立即将资源转用于新的目标。 Scam-baiting在其中冒充潜在受害者浪费诈骗者的时间, 早期的自动化方法[2,3]显示可行性,但依靠静态模板和固定的休克法,使得这些方法对适应识别并脱离bots的操作员无效.

blocks.en: Effective automated baiting requires resolving three main challenges: (i) dynamically balancing the conflicting objectives of prolonging the interaction and maintaining credibility; (ii) employing baiting strategies that are effective relative to the scammer’s observed behaviour; and (iii) evaluating agent adaptation through formal metrics beyond interaction length alone. We address these challenges through a game-theoretic framework enabling LLMs to learn effective baiting strategies via in-context learning, without parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 有效的自动诱饵需要解决三个主要挑战:(一) 动态地平衡延长互动和维持可信度的相互冲突的目标;(二) 采用与欺诈者所观察到的行为相比有效的诱饵策略;(三) 通过超出互动长度的正式衡量标准来评价代理人的适应性。 我们通过一个游戏理论框架来应对这些挑战,该框架使LLMs能够通过内文学习学习而学习有效的诱饵策略,而无需更新参数。

blocks.en: The framework operates after a call has been flagged as a scam and models scammer-baiter interactions as a two-player non-cooperative game. Strategies employed by each player are grounded in documented scam techniques [ 21 , 1 ] and persuasion research [ 5 ] , and payoffs are attributed to players based on their performance relative to their respective objectives. To build an optimal scam-baiter — one that consistently selects strategies that maximise scammer time wastage — Nash equilibrium (NE) is computed from empirically constructed payoff matrices. A baiter whose strategy distribution aligns with NE maximises its guaranteed performance against any scammer behaviour, making equilibrium proximity a principled measure of how effectively an agent has learned to play, and serving as the benchmark against which learned LLM behaviour is evaluated across repeated games.
blocks.zh: 该框架在呼叫被标为骗局后运作,而模型被标为骗局者-赌徒互动被标为双人不合作游戏. 每个玩家采用的战略都基于有文件记载的骗局技巧[21, 1]和说服研究[5],根据玩家的表现与各自的目标,将报酬归于玩家. 为了建立一个最理想的骗局赌博者——一个一贯选择将骗局时间浪费最大化的战略的骗局——纳什均衡(NE)是从经验构建的收益矩阵计算出来的. 其战略分配与NE保持一致的诱饵者,将保证的表现与任何骗局行为相匹配最大化,使均衡接近成为衡量代理人学会如何有效游戏的原则性衡量标准,并成为在反复游戏中评价所学到的LLM行为的基准。

blocks.en: This paper addresses the following research questions: RQ1 Can LLMs learn effective baiting strategies through in-context learning from repeated interactions, without fine-tuning? RQ2 Do LLMs converge towards NE strategy distributions through experience-based adaptation, and does proximity to equilibrium correlate with baiting effectiveness? RQ3 Which baiting strategies are most effective across LLM architectures, and to what extent do optimal strategies vary with architectural differences? RQ4 Which LLM architecture offers the most favourable trade-off between baiting effectiveness and computational cost for production deployment?
blocks.zh: 本文涉及以下研究问题: RQ1 LLMS能否通过从反复互动中学习的内文学习到有效的诱饵策略,而不进行微调? 问题2 有限责任管理是否通过基于经验的适应而趋同于国家执行战略的分配,接近平衡是否与诱饵有效性相关? 问题3 哪些诱饵策略在LLM架构中最为有效,最佳策略在多大程度上随建筑差异而变化? 问题4 哪些LLM架构在诱饵效力和生产部署的计算成本之间提供了最有利的取舍?

blocks.en: We evaluate the framework through 300 simulated dialogues across DeepSeek, Mixtral, and GPT-4. Delay and Counter Questioning emerge as universally effective baiting tactics, while optimal mixing ratios are architecture-dependent. Adaptive strategy selection achieves 28.9–79.7% closer alignment to NE than non-adaptive baselines. DeepSeek achieves the strongest baiting performance ( ≈ 60 % \approx 60\% baiter win rate; 42-turn average duration) at substantially lower cost than GPT-4, offering a favourable cost-performance trade-off for deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们通过遍及DeepSeek、Mixtral和GPT-4的300个模拟对话来评价该框架。 拖延和反质询是普遍有效的诱饵策略,而最佳混合比率则取决于结构。 与非适应性基线相比,适应性战略选择实现28.9-79.7%与NE更接近。 DeepSeek以比GPT-4低得多的成本实现最强的诱饵性能(约60%\约60%诱饵者胜出率;42转平均持续时间),为部署提供了有利的成本-性能取舍.

blocks.en:
The paper makes four contributions: (1) Empirically validated identification of effective baiting strategies via NE analysis, with architecture-specific deployment guidance.
(2) An empirical demonstration that LLMs acquire effective counter-strategies through in-context learning without fine-tuning, achieving measurably closer alignment to the Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines across all models tested. (3) A game-theoretic evaluation framework for adaptive strategy learning in adversarial human-agent dialogues, providing the first formal assessment mechanism for LLM adaptation in scam-baiting contexts. (4) An annotated dataset of 300 dialogues with turn-level strategy labels and utility scores, released 1 to support reproducibility and future research.
blocks.zh:
该文件提出了四项意见: (1) 通过NE分析以经验验证的方式确定有效的诱饵战略,并提供针对具体架构的部署指导。
(2) 通过不作微调的文字内学习获得有效反战略的经验性演示,实现与纳什平衡的相近程度,而不是所有试验模型的非适应性基线。 (3)在对抗性人与代理人对话中学习适应战略的游戏-理论评价框架,为欺诈情况下的LLM适应提供了第一个正式评估机制. (4) 附有回合级战略标签和功用分数的300个对话的附加说明数据集,发布1,以支持可复制性和未来的研究。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Scam Detection and Operational Defences. Deployed countermeasures against phone scams span network-level filtering (call blocking, telephony blacklisting [ 15 ] ), content-based detection (ML classifiers [ 12 ] , NLP script detection [ 6 ] ), and caller authentication with virtual assistant mediation [ 16 ] . All operate reactively, and caller ID spoofing further undermines filtering reliability [ 7 ] . Critically, no deployed system imposes a direct resource cost on scam operators; a blocked or detected scammer can immediately redirect effort towards a new target at negligible cost. This asymmetry motivates the resource-depletion approach pursued in this work.
blocks.zh: 相机探测与作战防御. 针对电话欺诈采取的对策跨越网络一级的过滤(电话阻断、电话黑名单[15])、基于内容的检测(ML分类器[12]、NLP脚本检测[6])和以虚拟助理调解的呼叫者认证[16]。 所有操作都是被动的,呼叫者身份识别偷窥进一步破坏了过滤的可靠性[7]. 关键的是,没有部署的系统给骗局经营者带来直接的资源成本;被阻止或被察觉的骗局者可以立即以可忽略不计的代价将努力转向新的目标。 这种不对称现象促使在这项工作中采用资源消耗办法。

blocks.en: Automated Scam-Baiting. Manual scam-baiting has been studied as a deliberate countermeasure [ 8 ] , with documented evidence that sustained engagement meaningfully occupies scammer resources. Automation efforts remain limited. Bajaj and Edwards [ 2 ] demonstrated LLM-generated victim responses but relied on static templates without strategy adaptation. Basta et al. [ 3 ] introduced multi-agent interaction and persona diversity, yet provided no formal strategic modelling, performance-based adaptation, or quantitative evaluation metrics. No existing system can characterise which baiting behaviours are effective, measure convergence towards optimal play, or adapt strategy distributions in response to observed scammer behaviour — this paper directly addresses these gaps.
blocks.zh: 自动相机-拜庭. 手工诈骗被作为一种蓄意的反制措施加以研究[8],有文件证明持续参与有意义地占用了欺诈者的资源。 自动化工作仍然有限。 Bajaj和Edwards[2]演示了LLM生成的受害者反应,但依靠静态模板而不适应战略. 巴斯塔等编. [3] 引入了多代理互动和人的多样性,但没有提供正式的战略建模、基于绩效的适应或定量评价衡量标准。 任何现有系统都无法说明哪些诱饵行为是有效的,无法衡量向最佳游戏的趋同程度,也无法根据观察到的骗局行为调整战略分布——本文件直接述及这些差距。

blocks.en: Strategic Reasoning in LLMs. The capacity of LLMs to reason strategically has been examined through cognitive hierarchy modelling [ 22 ] and multi-agent negotiation analysis [ 4 ] . However, existing work evaluates on small strategy sets, focuses on short-horizon interactions, and does not examine whether LLMs can update strategy distributions from performance feedback without parameter modification. This paper addresses all three limitations, providing the first empirical analysis of LLM strategy convergence towards the Nash equilibrium across repeated adversarial dialogues.
blocks.zh: 法学硕士中的战略理由 通过认知等级建模[22]和多代理谈判分析[4],对LLMS的战略理性能力进行了审查. 然而,现有工作评价了小型战略集,侧重于短视互动,不检查LLMS是否能够在不修改参数的情况下从性能反馈中更新战略分布. 本文涉及所有三个局限性,提供了LLM战略在反复的对抗性对话中向纳什均衡方向趋同的第一次经验分析。

blocks.en: 3 Game Framework and Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 游戏框架和方法

blocks.en: We model scammer-baiter interactions as a two-player non-cooperative game, operating downstream of a scam detection system where the objective shifts from classification to resource depletion. Game theory provides a principled methodology for computing theoretically optimal mixed strategy distributions in adversarial settings [ 14 ] . In turn, Nash equilibrium serves as a quantitative benchmark against which empirically observed LLM behaviour can be rigorously measured — a property that heuristic-based frameworks do not provide.
blocks.zh: 我们把骗局者-赌博者的互动作为双玩家不合作的游戏, 在骗局检测系统的下游运作, 目标从分类转向资源枯竭。 游戏理论为计算对抗环境下理论上最佳混合策略分布提供了原则方法[14]. 反过来,纳什均衡又作为一个量化基准,据此可以严格衡量经验观察的LLM行为——这种基于雄心力的框架没有提供的财产。

blocks.en: 3.1 Game Properties
blocks.zh: 3.1 游戏属性

blocks.en: Sequential Structure . Players alternate turns, with each scammer message followed by a baiter response. Each turn t t constitutes a message-response pair, creating dependencies in which prior actions constrain future choices [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 序列结构. 玩家交替转弯,每条骗取消息后会有一个诱饵者响应. 每转t t 构成一对消息响应,产生依赖性,其中先行行动制约了未来的选择 [10].

blocks.en: Information Structure . From the baiter’s perspective — the agent being optimised — the game has complete information. The baiter knows both players’ strategy spaces, the payoff structure, and the opponent’s type. While the scammer cannot distinguish a baiter from a genuine victim, formal modelling of this belief uncertainty [ 11 ] is outside the scope of this work; our analysis focuses on identifying optimal baiter behaviour given confirmed scam detection.
blocks.zh: 信息结构 从投饵者的角度——被优化的代理商——游戏拥有完整的信息. 诱饵者既知道玩家的策略空间,回报结构,也知道对手的类型. 虽然骗子无法将诱饵者与真正的受害者区分开来,但对这种信念不确定性的正式建模[11]不在这项工作的范围之内;我们的分析侧重于查明经证实的诱饵行为。

blocks.en: Perfect Recall . Both players retain memory of all preceding actions, enabling contextual reasoning throughout the conversation.
blocks.zh: 完美的回忆。 两位玩家都保留了所有前作的记忆,使得整个对话中都能够进行背景推理.

blocks.en: Finite Horizon . The game has a maximum length of t max = 50 t_{\max}=50 turns, known to both players. This bound is consistent with documented scam call durations in prior empirical analyses of scam-baiting interactions [ 21 ] and influences the scammer’s strategic disengagement calculus.
blocks.zh: 无限地平线。 游戏的最大长度为t max=50t_{\max}=50转弯,为双方玩家所熟知. 这一约束与先前对骗博互动经验分析中记录的骗取期限一致[21],并影响骗取者的战略脱离计算。

blocks.en: Zero-Sum Payoff Structure . The baiter’s utility is defined as the negative of the scammer’s utility, making any scammer gain an equivalent baiter loss. This captures the adversarial tension — information extraction vs. time depletion — while enabling efficient equilibrium computation via linear programming.
blocks.zh: 零悬赏结构 诱饵者的效用被定义为骗取者的效用的负值,使任何骗取者的诱饵损失相等。 这捕捉了对抗性的张力——信息提取与时间耗尽——同时通过线性编程实现高效的平衡计算.

blocks.en: Further modelling choices and their implications are discussed in section 6.3 .
blocks.zh: 第6.3节讨论了进一步的建模选择及其影响。

blocks.en:
Payoff matrices are constructed empirically from observed interactions rather than specified a priori, as the payoff of each strategy pair is contingent on conversational context that cannot be determined without simulation [ 20 , 19 ] .
We then use Nash equilibrium [ 13 ] as a benchmark for evaluating strategic learning. A Nash Equilibrium is a collection of distributions over each player’s strategies, representing mutual best responses, such that no individual player can increase their expected payoff by unilaterally deviating from their chosen distribution. Our approach is consistent with empirical game-theoretic analysis [ 20 , 19 ] , where payoff matrices derived from simulation are used to characterise emergent strategic behaviour in complex multi-agent systems.

然后我们用纳什平衡[13]作为评价战略学习的基准. 纳什平衡(A Nash Equilibrium)是每个玩家策略的分布集合,代表着相互的最佳反应,因此任何个人玩家都无法通过单方面偏离自己选择的分布来增加预期的回报. 我们的方法符合经验性的游戏-理论分析[20,19],其中从模拟中得出的回报矩阵被用来描述复杂多代理系统中出现的策略行为.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the framework’s capacity to enable strategic learning through experiments with three LLM architectures, analysing their adaptation, their equilibrium convergence, and game outcomes across 300 simulated dialogues.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三个LLM架构的实验、分析其适应性、平衡的趋同以及300个模拟对话的游戏结果,来评估框架是否有能力实现战略学习。

blocks.en: 4.1 Language Models and System Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.1 语言模型和系统架构

blocks.en: Experiments are conducted using three LLMs accessed via their API: Mixtral-8x22B-Instruct (104B total parameters, 12B active per token), DeepSeek-Chat (16B parameters), and GPT-4. appendix 0.D provides full configuration details. Each turn of the game comprises five sequential LLM calls, as illustrated in fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 实验使用通过他们的API访问的3个LLMs进行:Mixtral-8x22B-Instruct(104B总参数,每个符号活取12B),DeepSeek-Chat(16B参数)和GPT-4. 附录0.D提供完整的配置细节. 游戏的每个回合由5个相继的LLM调用组成,如图所示. 1 (英语).

blocks.en:
The scammer and baiter strategy selectors receive the conversation history and payoff outcomes from the current and 20 most recent games — the memory window determined empirically to balance historical context against prompt length — and apply chain-of-thought reasoning to sample a strategy from the probability distribution. Then, the message generators translate selected strategies into contextually appropriate dialogue using a two-layer prompt architecture, in which a base layer establishes persona characteristics and a behavioural layer implements the selected strategy as concrete conversational tactics.
Finally, the dialogue analyser extracts PII from baiter responses, tracks FPII completeness, and stores the turn’s data for later use. All framework components, i.e., strategy selectors, message generators, and dialogue analyser use the same LLM per simulation. The full implementation specifications and baiter-side prompts are provided in appendix 0.D and appendix 0.C , respectively. The scammer-side prompts are withheld in accordance with our ethics statement (see appendix 0.A ).
blocks.zh:
骗子和诱饵策略选择者从当前和最近20个游戏中获得对话历史和回报结果——内存窗口在经验上决定了在历史背景与快速长度之间保持平衡——并运用思维链推理从概率分布中抽取策略. 然后,信息生成器将选定的策略转换成适合背景的对话,使用两层的即时架构,其中基层建立人物特征,行为层执行选定的策略作为具体的谈话策略.
最后,对话分析器从诱饵反应中提取PII,跟踪FPII的完整性,并存储转子的数据供日后使用. 所有框架组件,即策略选择器,消息生成器,以及对话分析器每次模拟使用相同的LLM. 附录0.D和附录0.C分别提供了完整的实施规格和投注方提示。 根据我们的道德操守声明(见附录0.A.),扣压骗局的提示。

blocks.zh: 4.2 模拟数据集

blocks.en: 300 dialogues are simulated 1 , comprising 100 games per model. Each game is bounded by t max = 50 t_{\max}=50 turns, but might terminate earlier upon complete FPII extraction ( FPII = 1 \text{FPII}=1 ) or scammer disengagement ( S 10 S_{10} ). Baiter personas are set as naive victims with no prior knowledge of the scam, while scammer personas are set as authority figures from financial institutions.

blocks.en: Each interaction is recorded as a structured tuple whose complete schema is defined in appendix 0.E . The resulting dataset contains 10,247 annotated turns. Manual validation on a randomly sampled 10% of conversations confirms a PII extraction accuracy of 94% averaged across all models. table 2 provides per-model statistics on the annotated dataset released alongside this paper.

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.4 分析管道

blocks.en: Following completion of 100 dialogues per model, an empirical payoff matrix A A is constructed using the aggregation method defined in eq. 2 , and Nash equilibrium ( 𝐱 ∗ , 𝐲 ∗ ) (\mathbf{x}^{*},\mathbf{y}^{*}) is computed via the linear programming formulation using nashpy . To quantify learning dynamics, each model’s 100 games are partitioned into four chronological batches of 25 games, and the empirical strategy distribution for each batch is compared against equilibrium using two complementary metrics.
blocks.zh: 每个模型完成100个对话框后,使用eq. 2 定义的聚合法构建了实证报偿矩阵AA,而纳什均衡(x *, y *) (\mathbf{x}^{*},\mathbf{y}^{*})是通过使用nashpy的线性编程公式来计算的. 为了量化学习动力学,每个模型的100个游戏被分成了4个时间顺序的分批25个游戏,每个分批的经验性战略分配使用两个互补的度量衡进行对比.

blocks.en: Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence quantifies the statistical distance between observed and equilibrium probability distributions, with decreasing values across batches indicating convergence towards optimal play. Cosine similarity measures angular alignment between strategy frequency vectors, with increasing values indicating that the model prioritises the same strategies as equilibrium, even if exact frequencies differ. Together, these metrics distinguish models that identify the correct high-priority strategies from those that additionally calibrate usage frequencies optimally.
blocks.zh: Jensen-Shannon(JS)的分数量化了观测到的统计距离和均衡概率分布之间的统计距离,各批次的数值不断减少,表明接近最佳游戏。 相干相似度测量了策略频率向量之间的角相干,不断增长的数值表明模型优先排序与平衡相同的策略,即使精确的频率不同. 这些衡量标准合在一起,将确定正确高度优先战略的模型与进一步优化使用频率的模型区分开来。

blocks.en: 4.5 Baselines for Strategy Selection
blocks.zh: 4.5 战略选择基线

blocks.en: We evaluate our adaptive strategy selection against three baseline strategy selection methods, ranging from random selection to theoretically optimal play.
blocks.zh: 我们对照三种基线战略选择方法来评价我们的适应战略选择,从随机选择到理论上的最佳选择。

blocks.en:
Random Uniform . The baiter selects one of the ten strategies with equal probability y rand = ( 0.1 , … , 0.1 ) y_{\text{rand}}=(0.1,\ldots,0.1) .
This represents a strategy-agnostic agent and establishes a lower bound on equilibrium proximity, consistent with standard game-theoretic evaluation practice [ 14 ] .

随机制服 投饵者选择10个策略之一, 概率为: y rand = (0. 1,..., 0.1) y = rand { (0 1,\ ldots, 0.1).
这代表了一种战略不可知剂,并在均衡相近上建立了更下限,符合标准的游戏-理论评价实践[14].

blocks.en: Majority Strategy . The baiter deterministically plays the single most frequently observed strategy across all 100 games for a given model. For DeepSeek this is Counter Questioning ( B 4 B_{4} , 69.9%), and for GPT-4 and Mixtral this is Delay ( B 1 B_{1} , 33.9% and 26.7% respectively).
blocks.zh: 多数战略 诱饵者确定性地为特定型号在所有100场比赛中最经常观察到的策略。 对DeepSeek来说,这是反问(B 4 B_{4},69.9%),对GPT-4和Mixtral来说,这是延后(B 1 B_{1},分别为33.9%和26.7%)。

blocks.en: Static Prompting . Based on [ 3 ] , this baseline generates adversarial dialogue in the context of phone fraud. It relies on static chain-of-thought prompting, without any game-theoretic strategy selection, payoff tracking, or performance-based adaptation. We compare against their reported dialogue durations and PII disclosure rates for overlapping model configurations to isolate the contribution of adaptive strategy learning.
blocks.zh: 静态提示。 根据[3],这一基线会产生针对电话欺诈的对抗性对话。 它依靠静态的思维链来激励,而没有任何游戏理论战略选择、收益追踪或基于性能的适应。 我们比较了它们报告的对话期限和PII的重叠模型配置的披露率,以隔离适应性战略学习的贡献。

blocks.en: table 6 presents the optimal mixed strategy distributions — as determined by Nash Equilibrium — derived from the empirically constructed payoff matrices. Delay ( B 1 B_{1} ) appears in all three equilibria (DeepSeek: 12.8%, GPT-4: 11.9%, Mixtral: 28.9%), establishing it as a universally effective baiting tactic. Counter Questioning ( B 4 B_{4} ) features prominently in the DeepSeek (72.0%) and Mixtral (11.4%) equilibria. Information Fabrication ( B 5 B_{5} ) emerges strongly in the GPT-4 (54.2%) and Mixtral (23.7%) equilibria, indicating that certain strategy combinations prove effective regardless of architectural differences while optimal mixing ratios remain model-dependent.

blocks.en: Comparing tables 5 and 6 reveals that proximity to equilibrium correlates with baiting effectiveness, answering RQ2 positively. DeepSeek’s empirical Counter Questioning frequency (70.0%) closely matches its equilibrium prescription (72.0%), corresponding to its 41% scammer win rate. GPT-4 substantially overutilises Delay (33.9% vs. 11.9%) while underutilising Information Fabrication (13.6% vs. 54.2%), explaining intermediate performance. Mixtral achieves reasonable Delay alignment (26.7% vs. 28.9%) but fails to leverage Information Fabrication (9.1% vs. 23.7%), contributing to its 88% scammer win rate.

blocks.en: To assess the rate and degree of strategic adaptation, fig. 3 presents JS divergence and cosine similarity between each model’s empirical strategy distribution and its corresponding Nash equilibrium, computed across four chronological batches of 25 games. DeepSeek reduces JS divergence by 13.9% from batch 1 to batch 3, with high cosine similarity (0.975) maintained across batches 3–4, indicating stable identification of effective strategies alongside continued frequency refinement. The non-monotonic trajectory in batch 4 reflects ongoing exploration rather than premature convergence.
blocks.zh: 评估战略适应的速度和程度,图. 3 介绍了每个模型的经验战略分布与其相应的Nash均衡之间的相差和同声相近之处, DeepSeek将JS从第1批到第3批的差别缩小了13.9%,在3至4批之间保持高余弦相近性(0.975),表明在不断改进频率的同时,稳定地确定有效的战略。 第4批中的非模拟轨迹反映的是正在进行的探索,而不是过早的趋同.

blocks.en: GPT-4 demonstrates steady improvement across all batches (13.2% JS reduction; 6.5% cosine similarity increase), consistent with methodical learning that prioritises stable refinement. Mixtral achieves rapid initial adaptation (10.4% JS reduction in batches 1–2) followed by a performance plateau, indicating that it identifies candidate strategies early but fails to achieve fine-grained frequency optimisation.
blocks.zh: GPT-4显示出所有批次稳步改善(JS减少13.2%;同位素相似度增加6.5%),这与方法学习保持一致,该学习将稳定的改进列为优先事项。 Mixtral实现了快速的初始适应(JS在分批1至2个批次中减少10.4%),然后是性能高原,这表明它很早就确定了候选战略,但未能实现精细的频率优化。

Across all three models, scammer utility accelerates most sharply during the second quarter of the interaction (turns 13–25), with loss-game scores diverging markedly from win-game scores in this window. Within a single game, the baiter’s in-context adaptation has insufficient time to respond to this mid-game momentum before the scammer reaches credential completion, identifying mid-game fabricated credential sequencing as the highest-value target for improving baiting effectiveness.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our findings demonstrate an effective mechanism for developing strategic agents in adversarial contexts. Rather than requiring extensive parameter updates through reinforcement learning [ 18 ] or explicit strategy programming through rule-based systems [ 2 ] , LLMs can refine strategic behaviour through contextual learning only by observing historical performance patterns. This finding has direct implications for deployment scenarios where fine-tuning is infeasible due to computational constraints, limited training data, or rapid domain evolution.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,在对抗性背景下发展战略代理人是一种有效的机制。 与要求通过强化学习[18]或通过基于规则的系统制定明确的战略编程来进行广泛的参数更新[2]不同,LLMS只能通过观察历史性能模式来通过背景学习来完善战略行为. 这一发现对部署情况有直接影响,因为由于计算限制、培训数据有限或领域发展迅速,调整不可行。

blocks.en: 6.1 Implications for Adaptive Agent Design
blocks.zh: 6.1 对适应剂设计的影响

blocks.en: The architectural differences we observe challenge assumptions about model scale and strategic capability. The superior baiting performance of DeepSeek relative to the larger Mixtral model suggests that strategic adaptation depends more critically on architectural inductive biases than parameter count, with direct resource implications for production deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们观测到的建筑差异 是关于模型规模和战略能力的挑战假设。 相对于更大的混合模型,DeepSeek的上等诱饵性能表明,战略适应比参数计算更依赖于建筑诱导偏差,对生产部署有直接的资源影响.

blocks.en: The emergence of universally effective strategies alongside architecture-specific optimal mixing ratios reveals strategic learning operates at two levels. General tactical principles (Delay, Counter Questioning) transfer across contexts, while fine-grained optimisation requires architecture-specific calibration. This insight generalises to other adversarial domains, including negotiation, competitive debate, and cybersecurity defence, where both universal principles and context-dependent adaptation prove necessary.
blocks.zh: 普遍有效的战略的出现以及特定结构的最佳混合比率表明,战略学习在两个层面运作。 一般的战术原则(Delay, Counter Questioning)在上下文之间转移,而精细的优化则需要针对建筑的校正. 这种洞察力概括到其他对抗性领域,包括谈判、竞争性辩论和网络安全防御,在这些方面,普遍原则和取决于具体情况的适应是必要的。

blocks.en: The baseline analysis in section 5.5 reinforces these deployment implications. Adaptive strategy selection consistently outperforms single-strategy methods on equilibrium proximity, with the margin varying by model. For models whose equilibrium concentrates on a single dominant strategy, such as DeepSeek, the operational benefit of mixing is incremental. For models whose equilibrium distributes weight across multiple strategies, such as GPT-4 and Mixtral, adaptive mixing yields substantial improvement over fixed single-strategy methods, reducing JS divergence by 71.7% and 68.7%, respectively, relative to the Majority baseline. The comparison with static prompting [ 3 ] further demonstrates that game-theoretic feedback reduces credential exposure across all architectures, even when dialogue duration remains comparable.
blocks.zh: 第5.5节的基线分析加强了这些部署影响。 适应性战略选择一贯优于平衡相近方面的单一战略方法,幅度因模式而异。 对于平衡集中于单一主策略的模型,如DeepSeek,混合的操作效益是递增的. 对于平衡在多种战略(如GPT-4和混合战略)中分配权重的模型,适应性混合比固定的单一战略方法有显著改善,使JS的差异分别比多数基准减少71.7%和68.7%。 与静态提示 [3] 的比较进一步表明,即使对话持续时间仍然相当,游戏理论反馈也降低了所有架构的可信度。

blocks.en: 6.2 Deployment Considerations
blocks.zh: 6.2 部署考虑

blocks.en: The experimental results inform model selection for production deployment. DeepSeek emerges as the strongest candidate, achieving the lowest scammer win rate (41%), longest interaction duration (42 turns), and closest equilibrium alignment (0.102 JS divergence), all at substantially lower inference cost than GPT-4. In a production pipeline where only the baiter executes LLM inference, each turn requires three sequential calls yielding an estimated 1.5–6.0 seconds of latency, which falls within the 3–5 second pause tolerance documented in human scam-baiting interactions [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 实验结果为生产部署的模型选择提供了信息。 DeepSeek作为最强的候选者出现,他实现了最低的骗局赢取率(41%),最长的交互时间(42个转弯),以及最接近的平衡对接(0.102 JS差分),所有这些都比GPT-4的推论成本低得多. 在只有诱饵者执行LLM推论的生产管道中,每个转弯需要三次相继呼叫,产生大约1.5至6.0秒的延迟,这属于人类骗取诱饵互动中记录的3至5次暂停耐受性[21]。

blocks.en: The economic case for deployment follows directly from the cost asymmetry between automated baiting and fraud losses. At current DeepSeek API pricing, per-interaction costs are estimated at $ 0.10 − $ 0.30 \$0.10-\$0.30 , representing two orders of magnitude less than the documented average loss per successful phone scam [ 9 ] . The framework integrates with existing telecommunications infrastructure through three components analogous to deployed virtual assistant systems [ 16 ] , comprising call routing for redirecting flagged calls, speech-to-text/text-to-speech conversion for voice channel interaction, and data collection for maintaining game history across the strategy adaptation window. These findings answer RQ4 , identifying DeepSeek as the most cost-effective model for deployment.
blocks.zh: 部署的经济理由直接源于自动诱饵和欺诈损失之间的成本不对称。 按目前DeepSeek API的定价,每次交易费用估计为0.10美元-0.30美元-0.10美元-0.30美元,比每一次成功的电话诈骗所记录的平均损失减少两个数量级[9]。 该框架通过与部署的虚拟助理系统相类似的三个组成部分与现有电信基础设施相融合[16],其中包括用于重定向标注的呼叫的呼叫路由、语音频道互动的语音对文本/文本对语音转换,以及用于维持整个战略适应窗口的游戏历史的数据收集。 这些调查结果答复了RQ4,认为DeepSeek是最符合成本效益的部署模式。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced a game-theoretic framework enabling LLMs to learn effective counter-strategies in adversarial scam-baiting dialogues through in-context learning without parameter updates. Adaptive strategy selection achieves 28.9–79.7% closer alignment to Nash equilibrium than non-adaptive baselines and increases average interaction duration by up to 83% compared to static prompting [ 3 ] , with Delay and Counter Questioning emerging as universally effective tactics and optimal mixing ratios remaining architecture-dependent. These results demonstrate that game-theoretic feedback can activate latent strategic reasoning in transformer-based models, providing a practical foundation for deployable adaptive agents in domains where fine-tuning is infeasible or adversarial dynamics evolve too rapidly for static approaches. Future work should expand the scope of the game modelling, pursue validation with human scammers, and integrate with live carrier-level detection pipelines.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个游戏理论框架,使LLMs能够在对抗性骗局式对话中学习有效的反战略,通过不更新参数的内在学习。 适应性战略选择比非适应性基线更接近纳什平衡28.9-79.7%,将平均互动时间延长了83%,而静态导出[3],延迟和反质询逐渐成为普遍有效的策略,最佳混合比率仍然依赖架构。 这些结果表明,游戏理论反馈可以激活变压器模型中潜在的战略推理,为微调不可行或对抗性动态过于快速地演变以采用静态方法的领域的可部署适应剂提供实际基础。 未来工作应当扩大游戏建模范围,与人类骗取者进行验证,并和活载机级检测管进行整合.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.A Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 附录0.A 道德考虑

blocks.en: We obtained institutional review board (IRB) approval for this research before conducting any scam simulation experiments. Several ethical considerations guided our experimental design.
blocks.zh: 在进行任何骗局模拟试验之前,我们获得了机构审查局批准。 我们的实验设计有若干道德考虑。

blocks.en: Controlled simulation environment. All experiments rely on LLM-simulated interactions rather than engagement with real scammers or victims. This eliminates risks of harm to vulnerable populations while enabling systematic study of strategic adaptation under controlled conditions. We avoid the ethical complications that would arise from engaging actual scammers or deceiving potential victims.
blocks.zh: 受控模拟环境. 所有实验都依靠LLM模拟的相互作用,而不是与真正的骗子或受害者接触。 这消除了伤害弱势人口的风险,同时能够系统地研究在控制条件下的战略适应。 我们避免与实际的骗子打交道或欺骗潜在受害者所产生的道德问题。

blocks.en: Limited generalization of adversarial strategies. Any scammer strategies that prove effective within our framework operate under specific game-theoretic constraints (zero-sum payoffs, finite strategy sets, known utility functions) that differ fundamentally from real-world scam dynamics. Baiter responses are optimized for time depletion rather than credible victimhood. This means scammer strategies that succeed against our baiters would likely fail against actual victims who react to psychological pressure rather than strategic payoff optimization. This structural mismatch between simulated and real-world objectives substantially limits potential for misuse.
blocks.zh: 对抗策略的普及程度有限。 任何在我们框架内证明行之有效的骗局策略,都在具体的游戏理论限制(零和回报、有限战略集、已知的效用功能)下运作,这些限制与现实世界的骗局动态有着根本的区别。 为了时间耗竭,而不是为了可信的受害者身份,对Baiter的反应进行了优化。 这意味着对我们的诱饵者成功的骗取策略,对于对心理压力作出反应的实际受害者,而不是对战略回报的优化,很可能失败。 模拟目标与现实世界目标之间的这种结构不匹配大大限制了滥用的可能性。

blocks.en: Compliance with LLM terms of service. Our use of OpenAI GPT-4, Mixtral, and DeepSeek APIs complies with their respective terms of service. We did not attempt to bypass safety mechanisms or guardrails. All prompts operate within the intended use cases for these platforms.
blocks.zh: 遵守LLM服务条款. 我们使用OpenAI GPT-4,Mixtral,和DeepSeek API,都符合各自的服务条款. 我们没有试图绕过安全机制或护栏。 所有提示都在这些平台的预定用途范围内运作。

blocks.en: Dataset release protocol. To mitigate potential misuse while enabling reproducibility, our released dataset includes baiter strategies, messages, and performance metrics but excludes scammer prompts and dialogue content. This selective release permits validation of our learning analysis methodology while preventing direct replication of adversarial tactics.
blocks.zh: 数据集发布协议. 为了减少潜在的滥用,同时促进可复制性,我们公布的数据集包括诱饵策略、信息和性能衡量标准,但不包括诱饵和对话内容。 这种有选择的释放可以验证我们的学习分析方法,同时防止直接复制对抗战术。

blocks.en: fig. 0.C4 presents the Baiter Strategy Selector prompt, which implements experience-based strategic reasoning. blocks.en: Delay: Intentional prolongation of the interaction to consume the scammer’s resources.
blocks.zh: 延迟:故意延长互动以消耗诈骗者的资源。

blocks.en: Obfuscation: Produce unclear, incomplete, or contradictory responses to reduce the information reliability.
blocks.zh: 浊: 产生不明确、不完整或自相矛盾的对策来降低信息的可靠性。

blocks.en: Technical Difficulty: Introduction of artificial obstacles into the scammer’s proposed processes.
blocks.zh: 技术难度:将人为障碍引入骗局者提议的流程。

blocks.en: Counter Questioning: Employ probing questions to challenge the scammer’s narrative consistency.
blocks.zh: 反问: 利用探险问题来挑战骗子的叙事一致性。

blocks.en: Information Fabrication: Strategically provide false or misleading information to the scammer.
blocks.zh: 信息配置: 战略性地向骗子提供虚假或误导性信息。

blocks.en: Malicious Compliance: Perform misconstrued instructions that undermine the scammer’s objectives.
blocks.zh: 恶意遵守:执行错误的指令,破坏诈骗者的目标。

blocks.en: Conversation Diversion: Initiate an irrelevant discussion to disrupt the scammer’s predetermined script.
blocks.zh: 对话分流:启动无关紧要的讨论,以打乱骗子的预定脚本。

blocks.en: Pretended Naivety: Forced misunderstanding of fundamental concepts to frustrate the scammer’s efforts.
blocks.zh: 假装纳维蒂:强迫误解基本概念以挫败骗子的努力。

blocks.en: Verification Request: Request verifiable documentation or credentials to challenge scammer legitimacy.
blocks.zh: 核查请求:要求提供可核查的文件或证书来质疑欺诈者的合法性。

blocks.en: Reverse Engineering: Attempt to extract information from the scammer, reversing data flow direction.
blocks.zh: 逆向工程:试图从骗局取出信息,扭转数据流方向.

blocks.en: Base Context Layer (lines 1-3) establishes fundamental persona characteristics without rigid specification. The prompt defines general boundaries (naive, engaging) that make the persona attractive to scammers while allowing the LLM to generate diverse instantiations across interactions. This abstraction prevents memorization of fixed responses while maintaining consistent characterization.
blocks.zh: 基底上下文层(一至三行)建立基本人名特征,不作硬性规定. 即时定义了一般的界限(naive, exact), 使得人物对骗局者具有吸引力, 同时允许LLM在互动中产生出不同的即时. 这种抽象可以阻止固定反应的记忆,同时保持一致的定性.

blocks.en: Behavioral Layer (lines 4-14) translates abstract strategy selections into concrete conversational tactics. These instructions constrain the action space to align with the selected strategy while preserving base persona consistency. For instance, when "Delay" is selected, the behavioral layer guides generation toward temporal extensions (requesting clarification, expressing technical difficulties) rather than direct information provision.
blocks.zh: 行为层(行4-14)将抽象战略选择转化为具体的对话策略. 这些指令制约了动作空间与所选策略保持一致,同时保持了基本人称一致性. 例如,在选择"延迟"时,行为层引导生成向时间扩展(要求澄清,表达技术困难)而不是直接提供信息.

blocks.en: This separation lets us study strategy effectiveness systematically by isolating tactical variation from persona consistency.
blocks.zh: 这种分离使我们能够系统地研究战略效力,将战术变化与个人一致性分开。
